descriptionHtml:
Bug B24 · P1 · known

Delete: Hospital uses the browser's native confirm and shows no 'deleted' toast; Nursing Home residents cannot be deleted at all

Tickets: TFA-92579 AC 7–8 ready for qa; TFA-94514 AC 1 ready for qa · counts as a QA bug: yes · found on: dev + local

Note: Review 2026-10-14 (TFA-92579): no 'deleted' toast is AC 8; TC-24/S03 fails on the same evidence; Nursing Home has no trash icon and no screen calls snf.remove (TC-24/S05, dev U09).

Other cases of the same bug (counted once): TC-01/S16, TC-01/S17, TC-24/S03, TC-24/S05, TC-24/S28

Approach · OAT-06 Measuring How the Pilot Is Working (Usage Analytics) · S22 Code and doc read: the hand-off doc and field names, and two TFA-94514 behaviours with no code path on main (removing a Nursing Home resident, the end-of-pilot survey)

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • T1 Engineering prepares a simple hand-off doc so Vikram knows how to access the analytics data (TFA-94514 AC 9)
  • U12 Everything above fires correctly and is queryable through Vikram's existing Convex dashboard access, with clearly named fields (not an unlabeled boolean or an internal enum only a dev would recognize … (UAT OAT-06 closing line; TFA-94514 AC 8; TFA-94609 AC 5; TFA-94609 AC 6)
  • U7 Per physician per day: notes generated, handoffs sent, and time from Pre-Round opened to note complete are aggregated and queryable in Convex (UAT OAT-06 Test 6; TFA-94514 AC 6)
  • U13 Every AI call (pre-round summary, note generation, billing, Ask AI, photo capture, handoff) logs its total time and, separately, the time the AI provider itself took, and which model answered (UAT 3.5; UAT 3.9; TFA-94514 AC 7)
  • U2 Removing / discharging a patient is logged, in Hospital and in Nursing Home (UAT OAT-06 Test 2; UAT 3.3; TFA-94514 AC 1; TFA-92580 AC 7; TFA-92580 Analytics)
  • U9a Task reminders are also tracked through an end-of-pilot task-reminder survey: the survey exists in the app and its answers are stored (UAT OAT-06 Also confirm 1; TFA-94514 AC 2)

Test design technique: Equivalence classes (equivalence) — Check the same rule again with another class of input (Hospital / Nursing Home, other data); every class has to be right.

Given docs/pilot-analytics.md at e02167f; convex/schema.ts, convex/lib/patientActivity.ts, convex/lib/usage.ts, convex/surveys.ts, aiCallLog in convex/schema.ts; src/routes/snf, src/features/snf and src/data/snf.ts; convex/surveys.ts

When Read the doc as Vikram would; check every table, column and enum value the four behaviours, item 6 and item 7 use against the code; follow every link; search every Nursing Home screen for a control that removes a resident or logs patient_removed with nursing_home; read which survey kinds convex/surveys.ts accepts

Then Every table and field is described in plain words; values are readable (no unlabeled boolean, no internal enum without a meaning); the per-day average is explained; the doc says how to find a physician's rows; every link resolves; the doc is somewhere Vikram has and will keep; …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): TFA-94514 AC 8 / AC 9 + UAT closing line for the doc and fields. Evidence with file and line. Seen in the design read: the doc links docs/patient-activity-analytics.md, which does not exist; PR #86 deletes docs/ (Q9); userId opacity and fn names are Q8. …

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method DOC · Document check; lane planned in the matrix: manual (manual)

S22 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/OAT-06.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 1 row.

Issue type: Known product issue · environment local · tickets TFA-92580 rejected by qa; TFA-94514 ready for qa; TFA-94609 ready for qa

The analytics hand-off doc for Vikram links a file that does not exist and leaves out several aiCallLog fields, the Nursing Home has no screen to remove a resident, and there is no end-of-pilot survey.

Evidence: allure 7babdea9-…-result.json; code-review lane. Known (already in the S22 oracle's design read): the broken link docs/patient-activity-analytics.md (pilot-analytics.md:18), the NH remove hook used by no screen (src/data/snf.ts:36, AddResident.tsx:26), and surveys.ts:15 accepting only baseline/handoff_followup/feedback. New, minor: the doc omits aiCallLog ok/parseStatus/httpStatus/promptChars/responseChars/error (schema.ts:226). Pending: Q7 (missing survey vs TFA-94514 AC 2), Q8 (opaque userId and fn names readable for Vikram?), Q9 (PR #86 deletes docs/; where the doc lives), Q4 (what NH removal means).

Environment: local — main e02167f → 25acd727 (10-15/16 re-tests), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-c.
